ops.title: Codex delegation boundary: lanes end at working tree, Claude handles commit/push
ops.body:
# Codex delegation boundary

Codex (gpt-5.6) lanes — whether spawned via `Skill(codex)`, the `codex:codex-wrapper` agent, or `codex-ask` fan-outs — **end at the working tree**. They edit files; they never commit, push, or advance bookmarks. The commit/push always runs on a native Claude agent via `ccx vcs ship`, after reconciling the tree against each lane's expected fileset.

**Why the boundary sits there:**

- jj and bookmark discipline live Claude-side: ship resolves the push target *before the commit forms*, so a refusal (parked on someone else's bookmark, non-trunk target without `--bookmark`) leaves the working copy untouched. A codex lane cannot honor these semantics.
- The prek hook gate runs inside ship: auto-fixes are re-verified and folded into the commit; a hook that still fails after retry aborts with nothing committed. Lanes bypassing this would land unhooked commits.
- Shared-working-copy safety: ship path-scopes (`ccx vcs ship -m msg <paths...>`) and hunk-scopes (`--skip-hunk`/`--only-hunk`) so one session's commit never sweeps up a concurrent session's pending edits. A lane committing wholesale would.
- Empty-working-copy refusal: ship refuses `nothing to commit` instead of cutting an empty duplicate — the guard that makes "did a prior ship already land this?" a visible signal, not a silent no-op.

**Lane discipline that pairs with this:** a codex fan-out mints its root and lane roster with `codex-ask --mint-root <lane>...` (scratchpad-adopting; never hand-mint scratch dirs), passes each lane `-s "$ROOT/<lane>"`, and ends with a deterministic `codex-ask --collect "$ROOT"` the gate consumes — lanes are classified from disk (`no-run`/`died`/`completed`/`failed`), narration never overrides the disk record. Implementation lanes are additionally reconciled against the tree, because a shared working copy makes the tree the truth about the world, not attribution.

**Practical rule:** if a delegated prompt would end with "then commit and push", stop — cut the prompt at the tree state and do the ship yourself, path-scoped to the lane's fileset.
ops.when: when working on codex lane orchestration, shared-working-copy safety, or ccx vcs ship behavior
